tools.name: list_gyms
tools.description: Use this when someone asks which gyms or studios they run in GymFlexa, or a gym's id is needed. Returns gyms with id, name, currency, default language and last edit time, alphabetical, 25 per page by default. Not for finding a member.

tools.name: get_gym
tools.description: Use this when someone asks for one gym's opening hours, timezone, currency or default session length. Returns the gym's scheduling settings with up to 14 opening-hour rows, Monday first; an id outside the organization returns not-found. Not for free session slots.

tools.name: get_gym_availability
tools.description: Use this when someone asks when their gym has free slots or openings for a class or session, or which coming days are fully booked. tools.name: get_gym_schedule_summary
tools.description: Use this when someone asks how busy their gym is or how many appointments or sessions are booked each day, past or upcoming. tools.name: get_gym_payment_summary
tools.description: Use this when someone asks how much their gym took in, or how many payments succeeded, failed or were canceled. tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Use this when someone asks what their gym charges for a class, personal training session or other service. Returns catalog service names with price and last edit time for one gym, alphabetical, 25 per page by default. Not for what a particular member bought or attended.

tools.name: show_gym_overview
tools.description: Use this when someone wants a quick overview or dashboard of one gym.
